coverage.name: Chaffee County
limitations: Read the posted official sample ballot styles County, House District 60 and City of Salida: no Chaffee County ballot question appears on any of them.
No TABOR notice was posted on the county clerk election page as of 2026-09-26.

No list of participating political subdivisions (or signed coordinated-election IGA list) was posted on the county clerk pages checked on 2026-09-26, so non-participation (not_applicable) could not be established.
The "Buena Vista (fire inclusion)" style (BV_fire-inclusion.pdf) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26 and could not be read.

coverage.name: Buena Vista (town)
limitations: Participating: the town page states the municipal election on November 3, 2026 "will be coordinated with the Chaffee County Clerk and Recorder."

Unreadable: the county sample-ballot link "Buena Vista (fire inclusion)" (https://chaffeeclerk.colorado.gov/sites/g/files/lrnvjt2971/files/documents/BV_fire-inclusion.pdf) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26, and the "Buena Vista (not fire)" link points to Salida.pdf, so no Buena Vista ballot style could be read.
The town election page lists Mayor and Trustee races and no town ballot question; recheck once the Buena Vista ballot style is posted.

coverage.name: Poncha Springs (town)
limitations: No Poncha Springs ballot style or question appears among the county's posted sample ballots; the posted County style carries no municipal question.

No list of participating political subdivisions (or signed coordinated-election IGA list) was posted on the county clerk pages checked on 2026-09-26, so non-participation (not_applicable) could not be established.
The town website (https://www.ponchasprings.us/) returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-26 and could not be read to confirm there is no town measure. Owner review: confirm non-participation.

coverage.name: Salida (city)
limitations: Excluded (not housing): City of Salida measure "Publishing Ordinances by Title" (publication of ordinances by title only).
The City of Salida website (cityofsalida.com) returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on 2026-09-26; the ordinance and referendum petition documents could not be read.

verification.against: Chaffee County Clerk and Recorder official sample ballot, City of Salida style (Salida.pdf)

limitations: The sample ballot prints no letter or number for this measure; measure.number repeats its ballot heading.

Origin is recorded as initiated because the measure is a referendum on an adopted ordinance; the City of Salida's referendum petition page returned HTTP 403 and could not be read. Owner review: confirm origin.
Ordinance No. 2026-09 itself could not be retrieved (cityofsalida.com returned HTTP 403), so sources.resolution is null.
The sample ballot does not state the density or unit count of the zoning.
